searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — critique and twenty eight improvements the awtsmoos gives gevurah to guard ambition; awtsmoos.com improves when breadth never becomes blindness. 1. html count is not public route count; classify fixtures/templates. 2. do not wait on huge git status before lightweight route discovery. 3. dirty plus active owner means audit only. 4. refresh prior audit claims from current runtime before acting. 5. close sefarim tests/browser before using it as precedent. 6. source/test green cannot substitute for real layout verification. 7. generic scores cannot substitute for actionable timings/resources. 8. games need playable readiness, not dom readiness. 9. editors need initialized/responding workspace proof. 10. separate site owned console errors from extension/browser noise. 11. separate required resource failures from intentional optional requests. 12. page overflow and intentional internal scrollers need distinct checks. 13. test representative interactive pages at 200% zoom. 14. prefer native form/disclosure/button semantics. 15. preserve route identity; do not force identical visual styling. 16. avoid new dependencies for cosmetic repairs. 17. version changed static assets under the existing cache model. 18. inspect compact server before adding compact=true. 19. compare compact latency as well as bytes. 20. inspect cache/content encoding before merging css merely to reduce request count. 21. tests should protect user visible invariants, not obsolete dom trivia. 22. add new regression tests only after first source draft. 23. recheck scoped status/claims immediately before writes. 24. rerun sitewide matrix after every repair tranche. 25. secret scan before full snapshot publication. 26. include unrelated safe work as requested, never known credentials/secrets. 27. github push and production deploy are separate gates. 28. production smoke must test representative routes, not only the last edit. improved sequence finish known route → classify inventory → full runtime matrix → rank with ownership → complete file family repair → reread → focused tests → browser → performance → global rerun → next family → compact benchmark → secret/topology → full safe git push → deploy → production smoke. next action write the final phase three safeguards and exact execution tranche, then harvest the currently running discovery/verification jobs.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — final safeguards the awtsmoos gives a final mirror before the whole city is changed; awtsmoos.com must survive the skeptical user, tester, maintainer, and future stranger. 1. verify every counted route is actually navigable. 2. preserve canonical urls, redirects, and trailing slash semantics. 3. detect html catch all responses masquerading as missing js/css. 4. distinguish auth required pages from broken pages. 5. record viewport and device scale for layout checks. 6. check short height fixed/sticky collisions. 7. check primary touch targets and focus visibility. 8. check logical keyboard focus order after dom changes. 9. check native enter/form behavior. 10. check back/forward/reload state on stateful routes. 11. check reduced motion behavior where motion exists. 12. check long titles/content and hebrew/rtl fragments. 13. check empty/loading/error/success/disabled/selected states. 14. check local storage/history corruption tolerance where used. 15. check game pause/restart/focus loss behavior. 16. check editor resize/canvas initialization/dpr behavior. 17. check media autoplay assumptions and failure states. 18. ensure route indexes do not advertise dead experiences as finished. 19. separate broken external links from local runtime failures. 20. ensure debug/source map assets never block production. 21. keep large images/video off the critical path when possible. 22. ensure font loading never causes avoidable invisible text. 23. verify compact output syntax/mime for es modules. 24. verify compact cache key and noncompact fallback. 25. measure compact cold transform cost. 26. check route level css duplication before consolidation. 27. test shared changes against multiple representative routes. 28. ensure every new module has one real responsibility. 29. verify case sensitive import paths. 30. preserve utf 8/hebrew content. 31. confirm tests genuinely fail for the regression claimed. 32. never weaken tests merely to obtain green. 33. scan full snapshot for secrets and oversized generated artifacts. 34. fetch/check upstream divergence before push. 35. verify deployment uses the pushed commit sha. 36. smoke normal cache and cache busted production behavior. 37. inspect production health/error logs where available. 38. smoke representative route families after deploy. 39. reopen remaining work after every success. 40. continue until no safe relevant public route defect remains. next action write the exact execution tranche, then harvest every running census/test/audit/browser/mission receipt and execute the first safe ranked repair.
